semantic_and_scope_decisions: Q03: Both restrict only rolled hits by warriors and then add extra hits, semantically resolving uncapped extras; named before/after-roll timings retained. No literal uncapped-word requirement.

Q04 reader-a: pays one face-up undamaged hammer states quantity and eligibility but no item-state operation. Pay is not a defined synonym for exhaust; do not supply exhaustion/flip-down from summary or another answer. Missing cost procedure, not an affirmative discard-hammer instruction. Immediate-card disposal/persistent destination contextual per v4.

Q14: The actual question asks what happens IF Supporters is full. Both resolve incoming discard plus continued payment/draw. Numerical five-without-bases threshold is contextual to that conditional, not an independent request to define capacity. Q73 separately broadly asks how Mobilize and requires all capacity details per v4.

Q16 reader-b: evidence citation Daylight and Evening operations points to sections but does not itself assign Train to Daylight. Evening officer-operation context resolves Organize timing; Train phase remains unstated.

Q25 reader-a: birds cannot substitute when explicitly bird is genuinely ambiguous: it may be loose no-substitution wording, or wrong-direction cost wording. It does not expressly establish the requested ban on NON-bird payment of a bird requirement. Partial for unresolved reverse substitution; no assumption that it explicitly bans paying an actual bird card, which would warrant incorrect.

Q37: mandatory one-per-sawmill limited by finite supply semantically requires available quantity; no new voluntary-fewer permission is asserted. Separate general costs-not-waived rule is contextual to wood-production/draw question.
Q45: Organize own-warrior removal procedure contextual; question asks whether Martial Law increases cost.
Q47: all four operation names, officer availability/nonconsumption and draw timing required; individual operation procedures contextual per v4.
Q51 reader-b: At Evening establishes phase only, not final step after drawing/discarding. The actual question asks when capacity is checked; source 9.6.4 and summary explicitly put this last.
Q52: describing Refresh as flipping exhausted items conveys change of face, not repair; no independent contradictory repair assertion. No verbatim without-repairing requirement.

Q53/54: semantic printed-step count and combined allied-warrior/sword cap accepted. Reader-a Q54 increase ... by their number plus all undamaged swords is loose arithmetic prose but identifies combined cap ingredients; it does not explicitly add a second sword-count bonus. Read as total combined limit in context, and record ambiguity rather than invent a double-swords instruction.
Q56: hammer-exhaustion procedure contextual to mixed-suit/reuse/immediate-use capabilities per v4; reader-b does not affirmatively waive cost.
Q59: hostile-partner reset contextual to asked enemy/Allied powers, not new target.

Q61: Slip exception contextual because actual question explicitly concerns normal Move. Reader-a costs one exhausted boot is read as a boot exhausted to pay that move, not an explicit permission to reuse a previously exhausted boot.
Q62: ten-VP activation threshold contextual to asked taking-versus-activation/action-allowance distinction; no broad activation procedure asked.
Q67: simultaneous tie rule contextual to immediate-versus-end-of-action timing question.
Q68: warriors/pawn required semantically excludes building/token-only initiation.
Q69: own removal priorities and generic fallback contextual to asked ordering of effects.
Q70: subtract ignored hits in Count Hits resolves total adjustment; separate negations of die/cap changes not additional requested targets.
Q71: crafting-card disposal contextual per v4; neither answer grants Vagabond the non-Vagabond crafted item.
Q72: faction crafting phase/order contextual to named pieces/suit/question-mark icon question.
Q78: order/repetition and officer nonconsumption contextual to quantity and single Recruit scope; place normally means from supply.
Q79: Ranger Hideout is contextual per v4; any order/number does not affirmatively permit actions after ending Daylight.
